services.name: General Dental Checkup
services.shortDescription: Complete oral examination and scaling by a professional dentist.
services.longDescription: Get a premium in-home or in-clinic general dental examination. This package includes high-contrast visual exams, tartar cleaning (scaling), polishing, and structured lifestyle recommendations for optimal long-term oral hygiene. Highly recommended every 6 months.

services.name: Comprehensive Lab Panel
services.shortDescription: DHA-certified nurse home collection covering 85 essential biomarkers.
services.longDescription: The ultimate wellness tracker covering complete metabolic rate, kidney profiles, lipid profiles, thyroid parameters, liver performance, and vital blood elements. Collected by a DHA-certified specialist with highly accurate laboratory diagnostic reports returned securely within 24 hours.

services.name: Physician Home Visit
services.longDescription: Enjoy absolute convenience and personal clinical attention with a fully qualified, DHA-licensed General Practitioner visiting your home. Perfect for complete physiological evaluations, diagnostic screenings, acute disease checkups, and prescription issuances in the safety of your home.

services.name: Advanced Physiotherapy
services.shortDescription: Personalized motor-function rehabilitation session at home.
services.longDescription: A specialized one-on-one session with a premium licensed physiotherapist focusing on structural kinetic exercises, pain management, joint mobilizations, and full motor-function restoration. Highly effective for persistent back pain, neck pain, stiffness, or active athletic recoveries.

services.name: Full Body Checkup
services.shortDescription: Essential general wellness and metabolic blood screening.
services.longDescription: A balanced health audit detailing fundamental biochemical elements including glucose level, blood cell counts, basic lipid percentages, and kidney status trackers. Excellent starting indicator for general physical wellness.

services.name: Diabetes Screening
services.shortDescription: HbA1c & Fasting Blood Sugar tracking to audit diabetic health.
services.longDescription: Essential test to monitor and detect diabetes early. Includes HbA1c (Average 3-month blood sugar levels) and Fasting Blood Glucose, with professional interpretation and guidelines for metabolic support.

services.name: Thyroid Profile
services.shortDescription: TSH, Free T3, and Free T4 hormone measurement panel.
services.longDescription: Comprehensive test measuring Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (TSH), Free T3, and Free T4 to thoroughly analyze and diagnose hypo- or hyperthyroid functions. Crucial for understanding fatigue, metabolism, and hormonal balances.

services.name: Vitamin D Test
services.shortDescription: 25-Hydroxy Vitamin D level check to examine bone and immunity strength.
services.longDescription: Tracks active levels of Vitamin D (25-Hydroxy) to verify bone Density, muscular resilience, joint pain causes, and immune capabilities. Includes clinical dose feedback.

services.name: Post-Surgical Rehab
services.shortDescription: Specialized in-home therapeutic recovery following surgeries.
services.longDescription: Targeted physical therapy to safely recover mobility, strength, and stamina post-orthopedic or general surgery. Led by a clinical specialist with customized range-of-motion progressions.

services.name: Back Pain Relief Session
services.shortDescription: Targeted lumbar release and postural realignment program.
services.longDescription: A specialized physical care layout to address lower back pain, sciatica, and postural tension. Integrates manual mobilization techniques, therapeutic stretching, and core stability feedback.

services.name: Daily Vitals Check
services.shortDescription: Structured tracking of blood pressure, pulse, oxygen, and glucose.
services.longDescription: An in-home visit by a certified auxiliary nurse to carefully measure, record, and log cardiovascular and metabolic vitals. Ideal for keeping a highly reliable, continuous clinic record for elder or post-surgical patients.

services.name: Post-Operative Care
services.shortDescription: Complete clinical home assistance covering dressings and medications.
services.longDescription: Professional nurse monitoring including surgical dressing changes, medication schedules, pain administration, hydration checks, and vitals recording under the supervision of a clinical lead doctor.

services.name: In-Home Personal Fitness Trainer
services.shortDescription: One-on-one custom fitness session with a certified personal trainer.
services.longDescription: Work out in the comfort and privacy of your home with a certified fitness specialist. Tailored for endurance, weight loss, core strength, and muscle building using specialized portable equipment.

services.name: Sports Injury Rehab & Recovery
services.shortDescription: Targeted therapy for ligament sprains, muscle tears, and athletic recovery.
services.longDescription: Comprehensive clinical evaluation and treatment for acute or chronic sports injuries including ACL/MCL strain, shoulder rotator cuff issues, runner's knee, and ankle sprains.

services.name: Elderly Health Monitoring
services.shortDescription: Regular health monitoring and vitals tracking for seniors.
services.longDescription: Comprehensive at-home daily wellness checks, vitals recording, and assisted living monitoring tailored for senior citizens.

services.name: Personal Fitness Assessment
services.shortDescription: Body fitness evaluation and movement analysis.
services.longDescription: Professional body composition, cardiovascular endurance, and kinetic flexibility analysis conducted at home by a certified trainer.

services.name: Weight Loss & Body Composition Program
services.shortDescription: Customized metabolic and weight management regimen.
services.longDescription: In-home body fat analysis, customized cardio regimen, and endurance coaching supervised by a fitness specialist.

services.name: Yoga & Posture Alignment Session
services.shortDescription: Holistic flexibility, core stability, and spinal posture correction.
services.longDescription: Personalized therapeutic yoga session targeting spinal alignment, deep muscle flexibility, and mindfulness at home.

services.name: Senior Assisted Living Support
services.shortDescription: Dedicated companion assistance, mobility aid, and personal care.
services.longDescription: Comprehensive non-clinical and assisted support for elderly individuals including grooming aid, mobility encouragement, and daily companion care.
